mutations.name: the ceiling is ignored: every reader accumulates the whole body again, which is the 600MiB ERR_STRING_TOO_LONG crash on the catalog probe and 600MiB retained for a discarded GetUserJwt body

the crossing chunk is kept whole instead of sliced at the ceiling: the kept prefix runs past the bound by the remainder of that chunk, so the body described to the operator is larger than the ceiling allows
a truncated unary frame is parsed from its prefix as if it were the whole message: mintUserJwt returns a credential off a response the ceiling already discarded as incomplete
the catalog error text drops the truncation marker: a clipped error body is silently described as the whole upstream error, and an operator cannot tell it from a short one
